context_stem: To facilitate the effective implementation of this policy across the company, we commit to the following:
excerpt: Responsible Scaling Officer: We will maintain the position of Responsible Scaling Officer, a designated member of staff who is responsible for reducing catastrophic risk, primarily by ensuring this policy is designed and implemented effectively.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to maintaining a Responsible Scaling Officer role responsible for reducing catastrophic risk through effective policy design and implementation.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: We will maintain the position of Responsible Scaling Officer, a designated member of staff who is responsible for reducing catastrophic risk, primarily by ensuring this policy is designed and implemented effectively.

excerpt: The Responsible Scaling Officer's duties will include (but are not limited to): (1) as needed, proposing updates to this policy to the Board of Directors; (2) approving relevant model training or deployment decisions based on capability and safeguard assessments;
paraphrase: The RSO's duties include proposing policy updates and approving training/deployment decisions based on assessments.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: (1) as needed, proposing updates to this policy to the Board of Directors; (2) approving relevant model training or deployment decisions based on capability and safeguard assessments; (3) reviewing major contracts (i.e., deployment partnerships) for consistency with this policy;

excerpt: (3) reviewing major contracts (i.e., deployment partnerships) for consistency with this policy; (4) overseeing implementation of this policy, including the allocation of sufficient resources; (5) receiving and addressing reports of potential instances of noncompliance;
paraphrase: The RSO's duties also include reviewing major contracts, overseeing implementation and resource allocation, and handling noncompliance reports.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: (4) overseeing implementation of this policy, including the allocation of sufficient resources; (5) receiving and addressing reports of potential instances of noncompliance; (6) promptly notifying the Board of Directors of any cases of noncompliance that pose material risk; and (7) making judgment calls on policy interpretation and application.

excerpt: Readiness: We will develop internal safety procedures for incident scenarios. Such scenarios include (1) pausing training in response to reaching Capability Thresholds; (2) responding to a security incident involving model weights; and (3) responding to severe jailbreaks or vulnerabilities in deployed models, including restricting access in safety emergencies that cannot otherwise be mitigated.
paraphrase: Anthropic will develop internal procedures covering incident scenarios such as training pauses, security incidents, and severe jailbreaks.

excerpt: We will run exercises to ensure our readiness for incident scenarios.

excerpt: Transparency: We will share summaries of Capability Reports and Safeguards Reports with Anthropic's regular-clearance staff, redacting any highly-sensitive information.
paraphrase: Anthropic will share redacted report summaries with regular-clearance staff.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: We will share summaries of Capability Reports and Safeguards Reports with Anthropic's regular-clearance staff, redacting any highly-sensitive information.

excerpt: We will share a minimally redacted version of these reports with a subset of staff, to help us surface relevant technical safety considerations.

prior_counterpart_excerpt: We will share a minimally redacted version of these reports with a subset of staff, to help us surface relevant technical safety considerations.

excerpt: Internal review: For each Capabilities or Safeguards Report, we will solicit feedback from internal teams with visibility into the relevant activities, with the aims of informing future refinements to our methodology and, in some circumstances, identifying weaknesses and informing the CEO and RSO's decisions.
paraphrase: For each report, Anthropic will solicit internal team feedback to refine methodology and inform leadership decisions.

excerpt: Noncompliance: We will maintain a process through which Anthropic staff may anonymously notify the Responsible Scaling Officer of any potential instances of noncompliance with this policy.

excerpt: We will also establish a policy governing noncompliance reporting, which will (1) protect reporters from retaliation and (2) set forth a mechanism for escalating reports to one or more members of the Board of Directors in cases where the report relates to conduct of the Responsible Scaling Officer.
paraphrase: Anthropic will establish a reporting policy that protects reporters and provides escalation to the Board for reports about the RSO.

excerpt: Further, we will track and investigate any reported or otherwise identified potential instances of noncompliance with this policy.
